1	import { balanceDue } from './payments.js';
2	import { daysBetween } from './dates.js';
3	
4	/**
5	 * Get overdue invoices as of a given date.
6	 * @param {Array} invoices - all invoices
7	 * @param {string} asOf - report date in YYYY-MM-DD format
8	 * @returns {Array} invoices with status 'issued' or 'partially_paid' and dueDate < asOf,
9	 *                  sorted by daysOverdue descending (most overdue first)
10	 */
11	export function overdueInvoices(invoices, asOf) {
12	  const overdue = invoices
13	    .filter((inv) => ['issued', 'partially_paid'].includes(inv.status))
14	    .filter((inv) => daysBetween(inv.dueDate, asOf) > 0)
15	    .map((inv) => ({
16	      number: inv.number,
17	      customerId: inv.customerId,
18	      dueDate: inv.dueDate,
19	      daysOverdue: daysBetween(inv.dueDate, asOf),
20	      due: balanceDue(inv),
21	    }))
22	    .sort((a, b) => b.daysOverdue - a.daysOverdue);
23	
24	  return overdue;
25	}
